subject.title: Execute media and Talk QA scenarios through runtime boundaries

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101091 remain the implementation path for this issue, or should the runtime-boundary work be split before merge?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-labeled, current main does not yet contain the requested runtime-boundary executions, and an open linked PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Continue with the linked PR
options.body: Review and land the existing linked PR if its combined QA and runtime-support changes are acceptable.

options.title: Request a split
options.body: Ask for a narrower sequence if the Gateway client, Talk dispatch, Voice Call config, and QA producer changes need separate review paths.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the PR if maintainers decide the current shallow canaries are sufficient for now.

recommendation.title: Continue with the linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the existing linked PR if its combined QA and runtime-support changes are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the issue, the predecessor canary work, and the open linked implementation PR.
